spans.text: [18] AR: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ EN: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord.
They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.
[21] AR: أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ EN: Is the male for you and for Him the female?
[35] AR: أَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ EN: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees?
[8] AR: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ EN: Then he approached and descended

folded.id: he|is|most knowing of who fears him
folded.subject: He
folded.object: most knowing of who fears Him

spans.text: So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.
[12] AR: أَفَتُمَٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ EN: So will you dispute with him over what he saw?
[10] AR: فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ مَآ أَوْحَىٰ EN: And he revealed to His Servant what he revealed.
[4] AR: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْىٌۭ يُوحَىٰ EN: It is not but a revelation revealed,
[19] AR: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱللَّٰتَ وَٱلْعُزَّىٰ EN: So have you considered al-Lat and al-'Uzza?
[14] AR: عِندَ سِدْرَةِ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ EN: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -
[16] AR: إِذْ يَغْشَى ٱلسِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ EN: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it].

[32] AR: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌۭ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ EN: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones.
Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.

folded.id: most knowing|of|you when he produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers
folded.subject: most knowing
folded.object: you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers

spans.text: He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers.
[15] AR: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰٓ EN: Near it is the Garden of Refuge -

folded.id: no bearer|of|burdens will bear the burden of another
folded.subject: no bearer
folded.object: burdens will bear the burden of another

spans.text: [38] AR: أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌۭ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ EN: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another
[2] AR: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ EN: Your companion [Muhammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred,
[11] AR: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ EN: The heart did not lie [about] what it saw.

folded.id: on our|message|and desires not except the worldly life
folded.subject: on Our
folded.object: and desires not except the worldly life

spans.text: [29] AR: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا EN: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life.
[6] AR: ذُو مِرَّةٍۢ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ EN: One of soundness.

folded.id: or|has|he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of moses
folded.subject: Or
folded.object: he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses

spans.text: [36] AR: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ EN: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses

folded.id: or|is|there for man whatever he wishes?
folded.subject: Or
folded.object: there for man whatever he wishes?

spans.text: [24] AR: أَمْ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ EN: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?
[7] AR: وَهُوَ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ EN: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon.

folded.id: so|do|not claim yourselves to be pure
folded.subject: So
folded.object: not claim yourselves to be pure

spans.text: So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.
[30] AR: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ EN: That is their sum of knowledge.
[52] AR: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ EN: And the people of Noah before.
[54] AR: فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ EN: And covered them by that which He covered.

folded.id: then which|of|the favors of your lord do you doubt?
folded.subject: Then which
folded.object: the favors of your Lord do you doubt?

spans.text: [55] AR: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ EN: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?
[58] AR: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ EN: Of it, [from those] besides Allah, there is no remover.

folded.id: this|is|a warner like the former warners
folded.subject: This
folded.object: a warner like the former warners

spans.text: [56] AR: هَٰذَا نَذِيرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلْأُولَىٰٓ EN: This [Prophet] is a warner like the former warners.

folded.id: those who|do|not believe in the hereafter name the angels female names
folded.subject: those who
folded.object: not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names

spans.text: [27] AR: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ EN: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,

folded.id: to allah|belongs|the hereafter and the first [life]
folded.subject: to Allah

spans.text: [25] AR: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةُ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ EN: Rather, to Allah belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].

[31] AR: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى EN: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward] -
[46] AR: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ EN: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted

folded.id: you|and|your forefathers - for which allah has sent down no authority
folded.subject: you
folded.object: your forefathers - for which Allah has sent down no authority

spans.text: [23] AR: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌۭ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَٰنٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ EN: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allah has sent down no authority.
[2] AR: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ EN: Your companion [Muhammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred,

folded.id: your lord|is|most knowing of who strays from his way
folded.subject: your Lord
folded.object: most knowing of who strays from His way

spans.text: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided.
Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness.
